summary: Frontend-only test of new InvoiceDetailPage (PlanDetail-style standalone detail). Login as admin succeeded. Facturen list renders collapsed. Clicking a tenant row (Yashveer Kewalbansing) opens invoice-detail-page-<tenant_id> with proper structure: Terug pill, hoofdcard (h1 tenant name + Appt subtitle + status/open-count badges + right-side 'Totaal openstaand' label with colored amount), sub-card 'Openstaande facturen', sub-card 'Betaalde facturen', sub-card 'Acties' with WhatsApp/E-mail/SMS buttons. Reminder buttons open reminder-modal for the same tenant. Terug returns to list. Regression: no stale tenant-row-<id> markup found inside detail view; list still shows Nieuwe factuur + Genereer maand.
critical_code_review_comments: Invoices.jsx is now 1676 lines — consider splitting InvoiceDetailPage, TenantRow, ReminderModal, InvoiceModal into separate files for maintainability (>700 line guideline).

InvoiceDetailPage reads from filteredGroups; if the current filter/tab hides the tenant after status change, detail falls back to stale `detail` object. Consider fetching fresh group data or clearing filter when opening detail.
WhatsApp button uses <Mail/> icon (line 1212) — should probably use MessageCircle for visual clarity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: InvoiceDetailPage is fully functional and matches PlanDetail layout. Testids: invoice-detail-page-<tenant_id>, invoice-detail-back, reminder-btn-whatsapp/email/sms-<tenant_id>, invoice-paid-row-<id>. Tenant row click handler is at line 1561 (onToggle -> setDetail(g)).
verified_criteria: Terug button visible and returns to list
Hoofdcard shows h1 tenant name (Yashveer Kewalbansing), 'Totaal openstaand' label + amount
Sub-cards: Openstaande facturen, Betaalde facturen, Acties
No stale tenant-row-<id> markup inside detail view (count=0)
List regression: Nieuwe factuur + Genereer maand still visible
